indicator_name: GDP by production approach and aggregates, current prices, 1993-2009 (early sheets of table 4439)
description: ВВП методом производства и его агрегаты в текущих ценах, 1993-2009 (ранние листы таблицы 4439)
methodology: BNS table 4439, tenge years only (1993 restated in tenge at 500 roubles = 1 tenge: 29 423.1 million; 1990-1992 are roubles and are not read -- 1990 47 870.5, 1991 85 863.1, 1992 1 217 689.2 million roubles). GDP equals GDP_INCOME_METHOD 2000-2009 (the production and income totals are the same figure); fills it for 1993-1999.
